name: PulseLoader
description: Concentric rings that expand and fade outward from a glowing core in an evenly staggered sequence, with configurable ring count, size and period.
a11yNotes: Root uses role="status" with an aria-label (default 'Loading'); rings and core are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the ripple stops and rings are shown as static concentric circles of decreasing opacity.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Duration of one ring expansion in seconds.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Accessible label exposed via aria-label on the status element.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
